incidents.title: Incidents

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: Where alerts go. Every channel in the default policy receives every alert.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.teamsHint: In Teams: channel → Workflows → "Send webhook alerts to a channel", then paste its URL.
integrations.discordHint: In Discord: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook.
integrations.webhookHint: We sign each request; the secret appears after saving.
integrations.telegramHint: After saving, open the link in Telegram to connect a chat.
integrations.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Alerts stop going to it right away.

heartbeats.title: Heartbeats
heartbeats.intro: Cron jobs and workers ping a URL; we alert when a ping is late or reports a failure.
heartbeats.urlOnce: Copy it now: it's shown only once. You can create a new one at any time.
heartbeats.usage: Add to the end of your job: curl -fsS {url}

settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneHint: Used for schedules, reports and dates.

marketing.hero: Know about real outages first. Confirmed, explained, actionable.
marketing.subhead: Watchpost checks your sites and APIs from around the world, confirms each failure before it pages anyone, and lets your team acknowledge from wherever they are.

actionLink.title: Incident action
actionLink.doneAcknowledge: Acknowledged #{number}. The team has been told.

invite.signInFirst: You've been invited to a Watchpost workspace. Sign in, or create an account with the address the invitation was sent to.

invite.declined: Invitation declined. You can close this page.
invite.notPending: This invitation was already accepted, declined or withdrawn.

insights.budgetPaceOk: On pace to stay within the target this month.
insights.budgetPaceRisk: Downtime is using the budget {rate}× faster than the month passes; at this pace it runs out before the month ends.

insights.budgetsEmpty: Error budgets appear once you have monitors.

insights.scopeEverywhere: Every region sees it, so it's most likely the service itself.
insights.scopeSome: Only some regions see it, so it may be a network path or a regional server.
insights.noDeliveries: No alerts were sent for this incident.
insights.tileMonitorsDown: {count, plural, one {# monitor needs attention} other {# monitors need attention}}

insights.tileBudgetsRisk: {count, plural, one {# monitor is} other {# monitors are}} at risk of missing the target.
insights.drillIntro: Opens a labelled test incident that goes through your real alert routes, so you know who gets paged before a real outage. Acknowledge it to finish.
insights.drillConfirm: Start an alert drill? Everyone in your alert routes will be notified.
insights.drillBanner: This is an alert drill, not a real outage. Acknowledge it to see how fast the team responds, then resolve it.
insights.whatChangedEmpty: No changes to the address, certificate, settings or response time in the 24 hours before.
